scope: web service only; no desktop, provider delivery, account adoption or new commercial rights

response.email_verified: boolean: timestamp exists, stored contact epoch equals current notification_contact_version, timestamp not in future
response.email_verified_at: ISO timestamp only when current contact is confirmed, otherwise null

authenticated_status.authority: persisted current Bearer identity; no account/tenant selector accepted

all_mutating_requests.input: strict closed JSON objects; duplicate keys and nonfinite values rejected; never reflect values or unknown keys
all_mutating_requests.admission: before optional tenant/Bearer authentication; no query; one slash redirect boundary remains private
all_mutating_requests.csrf: existing authenticated CSRF applies in SaaS; only exact email/confirm and its single slash are purpose-proof public exemptions
all_mutating_requests.failure_fields: 422 may contain detail.fields listing only known schema field names; messages never contain supplied values

email_request.authority: persisted current Bearer, own current contact and epoch under account locks
email_request.provider_ack: existing Resend SDK accepted identifier only; not proof of delivery or domain verification
email_request.proof: 256 random bits; only purpose SHA-256, issued_at, expires_at, SV and contact epoch persisted; resend replaces old proof and has a durable 60 second barrier
email_request.transport: only after confirmed issue commit and Session close; uncertain commit never triggers mail; no token/URL/recipient in public response
email_request.client: await Api.session.ready; use browser session coordinator; no automatic retry or refresh after uncertain outcome

email_confirm.authority: purpose-only proof; new Session under empty tenant context; foreign Bearer irrelevant and never adopted; single-use conditional consume under lock
email_confirm.effects: only contact timestamp/epoch, clearing pending contact proof and classified audit event; no login, token pair, MFA, cookie, SV, role, gym or entitlement mutation
email_confirm.public_page: /auth/verify-email#token=...; GET never consumes; fragment enters RAM then history URL is cleaned before interaction; explicit submit only; no Api bootstrap, Storage, PII, external assets or auth cookies
email_confirm.client: public confirmation uses credentials:omit and does not mutate a session; no Web Lock or session invalidation needed

body.code: optional current six digit TOTP; exactly one factor when active
body.recovery_code: optional current unused 22 character recovery code; alternative to code

password_change.primary: existing password or explicitly linked Google reauthentication protocol; current signed access, persisted SV, personal factor generation and unexpired one-use proof must match
password_change.factor: current active factor required even after primary reauth; no email/MFA substitution; no factor input accepted when disabled
password_change.transaction: canonical hash, SV increment without overflow, refresh revocation, consumed primary proof, old password reset/contact proof clearing and obsolete pending enrollment clearing commit together; every old authentication authorization is invalid by SV; active MFA and recovery continuity preserved
password_change.browser: REVOKING path: committed success expires refresh cookie; never emits a new pair or adopts another identity
password_change.client: MUST use the SAME metodobase.browser-session.v1 Web Lock through full response parsing and Set-Cookie. Successful change clears current RAM/sensitive DOM and publishes invalidation; then direct user to login. Uncertain response must clear local access and publish invalidation without asserting server success; no automatic retry, refresh, readback using old identity or token pair fabrication. Freeze all input intent before awaiting lock.

failures.400: account_email_unavailable for unusable, expired, replayed, stale-SV or stale-contact proof; no account details
failures.401: current persisted identity/access unavailable; existing MFA errors preserved
failures.403_415: finite canonical browser admission rejected before optional auth; no refresh cookie mutation
failures.409: account_security_busy or exhausted session/contact version; never reset counters
failures.413_422: bounded/closed invalid input; known field names only
failures.429: persisted resend barrier or sensitive IP/subject budgets; no token in limiter keys
failures.503: account_security_unconfirmed, account_email_delivery_unconfirmed or account_security_service_unavailable; durable effects may have committed after lost ACK; no success or delivery claim

invariants: Existing users and verified Google bindings are not backfilled as email-confirmed.
A to B to A contact changes advance existing schema36 epoch and invalidate both pending proof and confirmed status.
Confirmation does not activate/deactivate accounts or gate existing login/rights. Introducing a commercial activation policy requires a separate reviewed decision.
No email change endpoint is introduced.
Schema targets22 through36 and accepted historical fixtures remain unchanged.
No real outbound mail is sent by tests; PostgreSQL37 and browser UI acceptance remain separate pending gates.
